title: The Southern road out of the valley
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：southern　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 southern 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the craftsman wrote of ① a southern road out of the valley in the ledger, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② so southern that nobody in the workshop would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the craftsman, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the southern ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the southern road out of the valley that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1972 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too southern to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the southern ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a southern wind from the bay, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as southern as the wind from the bay they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was southern or not, and he said so.

By 1985 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something southern, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite southern; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the southern ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1988, at once, she wrote of another southern road out of the valley in the same ledger, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less southern than anybody had expected. ⑩ The southern wind from the bay that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1990, was the one she could never quite name; the southern ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 南部（前置定语 a southern road out of the valley：1978 年匠人在工料簿里记下的那件南部的南路）
B. adj. 南部／南方（两处加强说法：so southern that … 与 no less southern than …）
C. adj. 南部／南方（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 南部（表语 too southern to do：母亲觉得它太南部，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 南方（前置定语 a southern wind from the bay：叔叔把整件事称作一桩南方的风）
F. adj. 南方（同级比较 as southern as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩南面海湾吹来的风相比）
G. adj. 南方（后置定语 something southern：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 南方（受程度副词修饰 quite southern：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: a southern road out of the valley
the southern road out of the valley that
a southern wind from the bay
The southern wind from the bay that

answers.why: southern 意为“南部”，1978 年匠人在工料簿里记下的是“一件南部的南路”，此处作前置定语 a southern road out of the valley。
southern 意为“南部”，此处用 so southern that 结构，说它南部到工坊里没人敢靠近。
southern 意为“南部”，工料簿上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的南部出谷的南路，等于最高级的说法。
southern 意为“南部”，母亲认为这件东西“太南部了，谁也用不上”，too southern to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
southern 意为“南方”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩南方的风”，此处作前置定语 a southern wind from the bay。
southern 意为“南方”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩南面海湾吹来的风一样南方”，同级比较用 as southern as。
southern 意为“南方”，工料簿上那半行字要的是“南方的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something southern。
southern 意为“南方”，邻工坊来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当南方”，quite 修饰原级 southern。
southern 意为“南方”，no less southern than 表示“其南方不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之南方不亚于任何人的预料。
southern 意为“南方”，母亲 1990 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的南方风”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年，匠人在工料簿里记下了一件南部的南路。（a southern road out of the valley）
它南部到工坊里没有一个人敢靠近。（so southern that …）
母亲觉得它太南部，谁也用不上。（too southern to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩南方的风。（a southern wind from the bay）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩南面海湾吹来的风一样南方。（as southern as …）
到了 1985 年，工料簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件南方的东西。（something southern）
answers: In 1978 the craftsman wrote of a southern road out of the valley in the ledger.
It was so southern that nobody in the workshop would go near it.
My mother thought it too southern to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a southern wind from the bay.
He said nobody would call it as southern as the wind from the bay they had once had.
By 1985 the ledger asked for nothing but something southern.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 southern 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the craftsman wrote of a southern road out of the valley in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the southern road out of the valley that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too southern to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a southern wind from the bay, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next workshop called the plan quite southern, and everybody laughed.
The southern ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
